The '''deep launchpoint transfer''' was the modern designation for the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] transporter complex in the [[Warlord's Deep]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient Rakata [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] took it over as a military outpost.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The deep launchpoint transfer is a Imperial-restricted transporter in the Tomb on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
